description.zh:
集群容器防火墙状态。
- **-1**：未知
- **0**：异常
- **1**：正常
- **2**：正常待确认
description.en:
The container firewall status of the cluster. Valid values:
- **-1**: unknown
- **0**: abnormal
- **1**: normal
- **2**: normal pending confirmation.

description.zh:
容器集群的ID。
>调用[DescribeContainerInstances](~~DescribeContainerInstances~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the container cluster.
>You can call the [DescribeContainerInstances](~~DescribeContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数。默认值为20。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20.
